headline: Pro football's first paid player
post_facts: Pudge Heffelfinger scored the only touchdown

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen ninety-two... professional football was born. For five hundred dollars.

scenes.label: Pittsburgh, 1892
scenes.caption: Allegheny Athletic Association team
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The Allegheny Athletic Association paid Yale legend Pudge Heffelfinger to play one game.

scenes.label: paid to Pudge Heffelfinger for one game
scenes.text: [calmly] He became the first known paid player.

scenes.label: Heffelfinger
scenes.caption: Playing for the University of Minnesota
scenes.title: He scored the only touchdown
scenes.text: [warmly] Against the rival Pittsburgh Athletic Club, he scored the only touchdown.

scenes.title: Pro football's birth certificate
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The ledger page recording that payment still survives.
